data.title: Ethereum On Track To Snap Its Longest Quarterly Losing Streak On Record
data.description: Ethereum (ETH) is set to break its longest losing streak on record, a prediction Bitmine Immersion (BMNR) chairman Tom Lee already made back in August.The second-largest cryptocurrency fell by nearly 29% in the fourth quarter of 2025, roughly 30% in the first quarter of 2026, and nearly 26% in the…
